mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 8.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a weak labor market that prompts central bank intervention, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 2 years.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate a broad-based demand contraction, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% year-over-year), rising inflation erodes real equity returns, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production over the past quarter indicates strengthening economic activity, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2 years.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 650,000 units for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening housing market that reduces consumer confidence and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 650.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2 years.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment growth and rising unemployment rates indicate a deteriorating labor market, triggering flight to safety and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (GDPC1 annualized growth > 2.5%), the economy nears its peak, leading to policy tightening risks and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth > 2.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3 years.
